WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT sf.zoneref, s.entrystat, sf.traitcount
  FROM scanfeatures sf
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    entrystat,
    AVG(traitcount) as avg_traitcount,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) as total_count FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  g.zoneref,
  g.entrystat,
  g.avg_traitcount,
  g.record_count,
  CAST(g.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count as fraction
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN total t
WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL AND t.total_count > 0
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10
